# Pricing & Plans

## Chatty Plans & Pricing

**How much does Chatty cost? What is the price of the Pro plan / Basic plan / Plus plan?**

- **Free** — $0/month: 50 AI conversations/month (resets monthly), 200 products, 1 team member, 1 email channel, 90 days chat history, all channels & integrations.
- **Basic** — $19.99/month (or $16.99/month annual): 100 AI conversations/month + $0.40/extra, 1,500 products, 1,000 custom answers, 50 URLs & files, 5 team members, unlimited email channels, 12 months history, full chatbox customization.
- **Pro** — $68.99/month (or $58.99/month annual): 500 AI conversations/month + $0.40/extra, 8,000 products, unlimited custom answers, 500 URLs & files, 10 team members, unlimited history, full AI channels, full analytics.
- **Plus** — $199/month (or $169.99/month annual): 1,000 AI conversations/month + $0.40/extra, unlimited products, unlimited custom answers, unlimited URLs & files, unlimited team members, advanced analytics, dedicated AI consultant.
- **Enterprise** — Custom pricing for larger stores. Contact Chatty to build a custom plan.

---

## Plan Feature Comparison

**Free:** AI conversations 50/month (resets monthly), products 200, custom answers 100, URLs & files 20, team members 1, chat history 90 days, email channels 1, chatbox customization default.

**Basic:** AI conversations 100/month + $0.40/extra, products 1,500, custom answers 1,000, URLs & files 50, team members 5, chat history 12 months, email channels unlimited, chatbox customization full.

**Pro:** AI conversations 500/month + $0.40/extra, products 8,000, custom answers unlimited, URLs & files 500, team members 10, chat history unlimited, AI channels full, analytics full.

**Plus:** AI conversations 1,000/month + $0.40/extra, products unlimited, custom answers unlimited, URLs & files unlimited, team members unlimited, chat history unlimited, dedicated AI consultant included.

**Plan limits raised (23/06/2026):** Free product sync 100 → 200, Basic AI conversations 50 → 100/month and product sync 500 → 1,500, Pro AI conversations 300 → 500/month, Plus AI conversations 700 → 1,000/month, Plus product sync 20,000 → Unlimited, Plus URL/file uploads 700 → Unlimited. If a merchant references the old, lower numbers (from an older screenshot or article), the new numbers above are current.

**Two things can make a merchant's real limit differ from the table above:**

- **A negotiated limit.** Some stores have an AI conversation limit set individually for them. When
  the number in **Subscription → View details** disagrees with the plan table, the number in the app
  is the correct one — quote that, not the table.
- **Older Basic stores get 3 seats, not 5.** Stores that subscribed to Basic before January 2024 keep
  the original 3-seat allowance. Every other limit was raised for them; only the seat count stayed.

**Public API & webhooks — Pro/Plus only:**

| Plan | API key generation | Webhooks |
|---|---|---|
| Free | ✗ | ✗ |
| Basic | ✗ | ✗ |
| Pro | ✓ | ✓ |
| Plus | ✓ | ✓ |

A merchant on Free/Basic who wants to pull conversations via the API or forward chats to their own server must upgrade to **Pro or Plus** (see `faq_klaviyo` → *Chatty Public API & Webhooks*).

---

## Connecting Channels vs. AI Auto-Reply on Channels

Connecting a channel (Email, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram) to Chatty is available
on **all plans, including Free** — this only requires the channel Connect step under
**Settings → Channels**. What's plan-gated is **AI auto-reply** on WhatsApp,
Messenger, and Instagram, which requires **Pro or Plus** (see
`faq_ai-agent-settings` → *AI Channels*). A merchant asking "which plan do I need
for WhatsApp" usually means connecting it — that's free; only mention the Pro/Plus
requirement if they specifically want the AI answering on that channel.

---

## Free Trial & Refund Policy

**Free trial:** All paid plans include a **7-day free trial**. Cancel anytime during the trial.

**30-day Money Back Guarantee** applies when:
- You don't wish to continue after the first month
- You cancel before the first billing cycle ends
- You forgot to cancel the trial or accidentally chose a paid plan without using it in the first month

For a refund, contact support with a **screenshot of the Shopify charge** (showing app name, billing cycle, and amount).

---

## AI Conversation Limits

- **Free:** 50/month — resets monthly (no extra conversations available)
- **Basic:** 100/month — extra at $0.40/conversation
- **Pro:** 500/month — extra at $0.40/conversation
- **Plus:** 1,000/month — extra at $0.40/conversation

**When Free plan limit is reached:** The AI agent pauses for the rest of the month and the quota resets to 50 at the start of the next month. Conversations can still be handled manually in Inbox in the meantime.

**When paid plan limit is reached:** Extra conversations are charged at $0.40 each (unless a spending limit is set).

---

## Checking Usage & Setting a Spending Limit

**Check usage:**
1. Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View details**
2. Check **AI conversation** usage (conversations consumed this billing cycle)
3. Usage resets on your billing cycle date (not calendar month)
4. Email notifications sent at 80% and 100% of limit

**Set a spending limit:**
1. Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View details → Change limit**
2. Enter your budget limit → **Save**

Once the limit is reached, AI stops responding until the next billing cycle. Human agents can still handle conversations.

Tip: Set limit 15–20% above expected usage to handle busy periods.

---

## Extra Charges

Extra charges appear when AI conversations exceed your monthly plan limit — charged at **$0.40 per extra conversation**.

Set a spending cap via **Chatty → Subscription → View details → Change limit** to control this. Human agent responses have no per-conversation charge.

If you believe a charge was incorrect (e.g., system miscalculation), contact support with a **screenshot of the Shopify billing section** — the team will investigate and process a refund if the charge was an error.

---

## Charged Unexpectedly / Forgot to Cancel Trial

Chatty does not automatically upgrade plans. However, if you signed up for a paid trial and did not downgrade before the trial ended, Shopify charged you when the new cycle began.

**To stop future charges:** Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View plans** → select the **Free plan**.

**For a refund:** Contact support with a screenshot of the Shopify charge (showing app name, billing cycle, and amount) — the team will review and process a refund if applicable.

---

## Cancelling / Downgrading to Free

Go to **Chatty → Subscription → View plans** → select the **Free plan** → confirm.

Do this before your next billing cycle to avoid charges. Downgrading does not delete your data or settings.

---

## Applying a Discount Code

Go to **Chatty → Subscription** and enter the code in the **Discount Code** field before upgrading.

If the code shows as invalid, make sure you are on the correct plan (some codes are plan-specific). Contact support if the code still doesn't work.

---

## Annual Billing Discount

Save approximately **15%** by choosing annual billing:
- Basic: $16.99/month
- Pro: $58.99/month
- Plus: $169.99/month

---

## Bulk / Multi-Store Discount

A **20% lifetime bulk discount** is available for merchants running multiple stores:

- Applies to **monthly Pro or Plus** plans only.
- Requires **at least 2 stores on Pro or above** to qualify (they do **not** all need the same plan).
- **Not** available for the Basic plan.
- **Cannot** be combined with annual plans (annual already includes ~15–17% off). A store on annual must switch to monthly to use the bulk discount.

> Each store is billed separately by Shopify, so the discount code is applied per store. Collect the merchant's store count and current plans, then forward the request to the team — do not promise eligibility before confirming.

---

## Legacy Plan Price Changed

Contact support with a **screenshot of your Shopify billing history**. If you had an active discount or legacy pricing that should have been honored, the team can escalate to the billing team to review and restore your previous pricing. Refunds for the price difference can be requested if applicable.

---

## Shopify App Credits

Go to **Shopify Admin** → **Settings** → **Billing** → **App credits**. Credits appear here and can offset future app usage charges.

---

## Billing Date Format

Chatty uses **MM/DD/YYYY** format. "Renews on 04/12/2026" means **April 12, 2026** — not December 4.

---

## AI Scenario Limits

| Plan | Scenarios |
|------|-----------|
| Free / Basic | 5 |
| Pro | 15 |
| Plus | Unlimited |

Extensions beyond plan limits require PM approval. Contact support and explain your use cases — the more specific you are, the faster the request can be processed.

---

## Stores with 10,000+ Products

Yes, AI product recommendations work — but it requires manual backend configuration beyond the standard 5,000-product limit.

Contact support with your total product count and monthly order volume. For stores with 10,000+ products and 100+ orders/month, a demo call with the product team is recommended.

---

## Extending Plan Limits

Contact support and share what you need — the team will review and confirm if an extension is possible. Extensions up to the next plan's level are sometimes available as a one-time accommodation, subject to team approval.

Do not promise the merchant that an extension will be granted — collect the request and forward it to the team.

# Chatty — Knowledge Base

## Product Overview

Chatty is a Shopify app that helps merchants communicate with store visitors via live chat, automate customer support with an AI chatbot (built on a secure, enterprise-grade large language model), and build self-serve FAQ help centers. Chatty is designed as an AI-first chat platform specifically for eCommerce stores, turning customer conversations into sales opportunities.

Built for Shopify badge. Available on Shopify App Store. 4.9 stars with 1,700+ reviews.

## Plans

| Feature | Free | Basic ($19.99/mo) | Pro ($68.99/mo) | Plus ($199/mo) |
|---------|------|--------------------|------------------|---------------------|
| AI conversations | 50/month | 100/month | 500/month | 1,000/month |
| Additional conversations | N/A | $0.40 each | $0.40 each | $0.40 each |
| Products for AI training | 200 | 1,500 | 8,000 | Unlimited |
| Team members | 1 | 5 | 10 | Unlimited |
| Auto-translation languages | 1 | 2 | 9 | Unlimited |
| Chat history | 90 days | 12 months | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Email channel | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Smart product recommendations | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| CSAT survey | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cart booster | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Dedicated AI consultant | No | No | No | Yes |

Annual billing: ~15% savings. 7-day free trial for paid plans. 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Core Features

### Live Chat
Real-time messaging between merchants and store visitors. Key capabilities:
- **Inbox**: Unified inbox to manage all conversations. Includes customer details panel, conversation details, chat zone with rich text editor.
- **Channels**: Email, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp — all synced into one inbox.
- **Contacts**: Customer management with tags, notes, and conversation history.
- **Team**: Invite team members, assign roles, manage conversation assignments.
- **Quick Replies**: Pre-saved response templates for faster replies.
- **Proactive Chat**: Behavior-triggered messages to engage visitors (e.g., time on page, specific page visit).
- **Real-time Translation**: Auto-translate messages between merchant and customer languages.

### AI agent
AI-powered chatbot that handles customer questions 24/7, trained on the merchant's store data:
- **AI Conversations**: Automatic responses to customer questions. AI shows as assignee in conversation details. Team can join AI conversations at any time.
- **Chat Summary**: When conversation transfers to human, AI summarizes the full conversation with language detection, issue highlights, and response suggestions.
- **Data Sources**:
  - *Store data* (auto-synced): Products (name, description, variants, pricing, inventory, metafields), discounts, markets, FAQs, policies (shipping, return, privacy, terms).
  - *Custom data* (manual): Individual questions, URLs/websites, files (.JSON, .TXT, .PDF, .CSV — max 2MB).
  - Products sync daily at 00:00 UTC. Only published, in-stock products are trained.
- **AI Skills**:
  - *Shopping skills*: Smart recommendations (bestsellers, new arrivals, sales, special occasions — auto top 20 by sales, updated daily), size guide (upload images, per-product assignment), inventory status, Product Quiz (Pro/Plus — a short multiple-choice quiz the AI runs to narrow down and recommend products, distinct from static recommendation cards).
  - *Customer support skills*: Transfer to human, refund/return form, order tracking in chat.
  - AI can also read a **customer-sent product photo** and match it against the synced catalog, and can read **Shopify customer tags** (e.g. VIP, wholesale) as context for personalization when the customer is logged in.
- **In-Chat Product Detail Preview**: Tapping a product card in the chat opens a detail view inside the chatbox — image gallery, variant selection, live price, stock badge, and Add to cart — without leaving the conversation.
- **AI Settings**: Bot name, avatar, welcome message, custom instructions (tone, response style, specific scenarios), AI availability (based on team online hours), AI channels.
- **Test & Optimize**: Test zone to preview AI responses before going live. Review unresolved questions to improve training.

### Chatbox
The chat widget displayed on the merchant's storefront:
- **General**: Turn on/off chatbox, enable chat focus mode, set header (logo, heading, description), configure blocks (Contact us, Order tracking, FAQs, Categories).
- **Appearance**: Brand colors (preset or custom), chatbox button (launcher icon, size, alignment), chatbox style (navigation mode, mobile ratio).
- **Advanced**: Deep links (open specific chatbox sections via URL), display rules (devices, pages), continue-as-email, custom CSS.
- **Contact Button**: Add contact methods — supports 11 methods: WhatsApp, Messenger, Phone, Email, Instagram, Telegram, Skype, Line, Zalo, TikTok, SMS.
- **Embedded Chatbox**: Embed chatbox directly in page content instead of floating widget.

### FAQ Builder
Build a self-serve knowledge hub:
- **Categories**: Organize questions into categories with icons and descriptions.
- **Questions**: Add questions with rich text answers, assign to categories.
- **FAQs Page**: Dedicated FAQ page on the storefront with customizable theme.
- **FAQs Block**: Show selected FAQs inside the chatbox.
- **FAQs Analytics**: Track views, clicks, and search queries.
- **Export**: Export questions as CSV file.
- **Translation**: Translate FAQs into multiple languages.

### Order Tracking
Customers can track orders directly in the chatbox. Supports Shopify order tracking and third-party tracking integrations.

### Mobile & Web App
- **Mobile App**: Manage conversations on the go (iOS/Android). Receive push notifications for new messages.
- **Web App**: Browser-based admin dashboard at app.chatty.net.

### Integrations
- **Klaviyo**: Sync customer data (contacts, tags, conversation counts, timestamps) to Klaviyo for targeted email/SMS campaigns. Requires Klaviyo API key with Read/Write access for Lists and Profiles.
- **Zendesk**: Connect Zendesk for unified helpdesk management.
- **Joy Loyalty**: Show loyalty data (points, tier) in customer conversations.
- **Air Reviews**: Connect product reviews for AI training context.
- **Powerful Contact Form**: Integrate contact form submissions.
- **Website**: Connect external website for AI data training.

### Notifications
Configure notification preferences for new messages, assignments, and other events.

### Analytics
Track conversation metrics, AI performance, response times, and customer satisfaction. The **Sales** tab includes a **Chat to Sale** report (two sub-tabs: **Sales** and **Operations & Team**) showing revenue and orders generated by conversations and which staff contributed — see `faq_analytics` for tab-level detail and plan gating.

### Online Hours
Set business hours to control online/offline status. Affects chatbox display and AI availability settings.

### Translation
Translate app interface and FAQs into multiple languages. Number of languages depends on plan.

### General Settings
App-wide configuration: branding, defaults, display preferences.

## Channel Details

### Email Channel
- Connect one email to Chatty via email forwarding.
- Default sender: noreply@chattyemail.com (customizable with domain verification).
- "Continue as email" feature lets customers switch from live chat to email.
- Conversation history sent to customer when ticket is marked solved.

### Facebook Messenger & Instagram
- Connect via Facebook account — link fanpages to sync messages.
- Messages appear in Chatty inbox with platform icon indicators.
- Disconnecting doesn't remove existing conversations.

### WhatsApp
- Connect multiple WhatsApp accounts.
- Requires: Business Facebook page, WhatsApp Business account linked to that page, admin access to both.

## Key Terminology

| Term | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| AI conversation | A customer chat handled by AI agent |
| Transfer | When AI hands off conversation to a human agent |
| Data source | Information used to train the AI (products, FAQs, custom data) |
| AI skill | Specialized capability for AI (recommendations, size guide, etc.) |
| Chatbox | The chat widget displayed on the storefront |
| Deep link | URL that opens a specific chatbox section directly |
| Proactive chat | Automated messages triggered by visitor behavior |
| Quick reply | Pre-saved response template for faster messaging |
| Contact button | Floating button with multiple contact method options |
| CSAT | Customer Satisfaction survey (Pro+ plans) |
| Smart recommendations | AI-powered product suggestions based on collections |

## Common Issues

- **Chatbox not showing on store**: Check if chatbox is turned on (Chatbox > General > Turn on), app embed is enabled in Shopify theme editor, and display rules (devices/pages) aren't excluding the page.
- **AI not responding**: Verify AI agent is turned on, live chat block is enabled in chatbox, data sources are synced, and AI has been trained on sufficient data.
- **Email channel not connecting (Outlook)**: Organization's Outlook settings may block automatic email forwarding. Contact IT admin to allow email forwarding.
- **Online status not showing**: Contact Us block must be enabled. Go to Chatbox > General > Blocks > turn on "Contact us".
- **WhatsApp not connecting**: Ensure you have a Business Facebook page, WhatsApp Business account linked to it, and admin access to both accounts.
- **Translation not showing on store**: Website must support the language first. In Shopify Admin > Settings > Languages, add and publish the language before enabling it in Chatty.
- **AI recommending wrong products**: Check Smart Recommendations collections in AI Skills. Disable smart sync if auto-selected products aren't relevant. Manually curate product lists.
- **FAQ page not showing after uninstall/reinstall**: After uninstalling, Chatty's code may remain disabled. Check Shopify Admin > Online Store > Pages for orphaned FAQ pages.
- **Order tracking not working**: Ensure Order Tracking block is enabled in chatbox. Verify Shopify order tracking info is properly set up.
- **Products not appearing in AI training**: Only published, in-stock products are trained. Products sync daily at 00:00 UTC. Check product count against plan limit.

## Privacy & Compliance

- **AI Compliance**: Chatty's AI follows data privacy standards. Customer conversation data is used only for AI training within the merchant's store scope.
- **Cookie Policy**: Chatty uses cookies for session management and chatbox functionality.
- **Data Access**: App accesses customer data (names, emails, addresses, browsing behavior), store owner info, product catalogs, orders, and discounts to function.

## Proactive Chat Overview

Proactive chat lets you send targeted messages to website visitors before they ask questions. Instead of waiting for customers to reach out, you can engage them at key moments in their shopping journey.

**Use cases:**
- Greet new visitors and guide them to products
- Recover abandoned carts with incentives
- Grow your email list with exclusive discount offers
- Recommend bestsellers when customers show buying intent

## Proactive Chat Templates

Chatty provides pre-built templates for common scenarios:

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Welcome visitors | Greet visitors with personalized messages to make them feel special |
| Subscribe newsletter | Capture customer email with hot deals, exclusive updates and rewards |
| Product recommendation | Boost sales by recommending hot-deals, cross-sell or upsell products |
| Cart booster | Convince customers to buy by offering them a small discount in the cart |
| Abandoned cart reminder | Encourage customers to complete their order after leaving items in cart |
| View cart | Send a message automatically when a visitor opens the cart page — timed at the highest-intent moment right before checkout |
| Collection boost | Boost sales when customers are browsing collection pages |
| Remove items from cart | Reassure customers when they remove items from the cart |
| Search page | Proactively guide users to search via the chatbot for more accurate results |

## View Cart Trigger (added 29/05/2026)

The **View Cart** proactive chat trigger sends a message automatically when a visitor views the
cart page, after a configurable delay (default **5 seconds**), and shows at most **once per
session**. Set it up the same way as other proactive chat templates: **Proactive chat → Create
proactive chat → View cart**.

## Trigger Priority When Multiple Campaigns Qualify

Only **one** proactive chat is shown at a time. When more than one trigger's conditions are met
at once, Chatty picks the single highest-priority trigger in this fixed order:

**Cart Booster → Abandoned Cart → View Cart → Remove Items from Cart → Product → Collection → Search → Subscribe → Welcome**

Other caps that apply regardless of which triggers are configured:
- **Maximum 5 proactive chats per visitor session**, across all triggers combined.
- **View Cart does not show** if Cart Booster already displayed in the same session.

## Proactive Chat Analytics

The proactive chat dashboard shows performance metrics per campaign:
- **View** — number of times the campaign was shown to visitors
- **CTR** — click-through rate (clicks / views)
- **Revenue** — revenue attributed to the campaign
- **Order** — number of orders attributed to the campaign

Filter by date range and compare against a previous period. Campaigns can be sorted by Priority and filtered by Active / Inactive status.

## How to Set Up Proactive Chat

1. Go to **Proactive chat**
2. Click **Create proactive chat**
3. Choose your campaign type
4. Configure settings:

**Campaign details:**
- Campaign name
- Activate campaign toggle

**Targeting:**
- Trigger options: when to send the message
- Pages: which pages show this campaign (press Enter after each URL to add)
- Audience: all visitors or returning customers
- Devices: desktop, mobile, or both
- Display time: after page load, after scroll percentage, or after time delay
- Display duration: how long the campaign stays visible

**Message content:**
- Proactive message: text shown above the chatbox
- Rich content: include product suggestions (available for Product recommendations and Cart booster)
- Chat message: message sent when customers click the teaser (discount sent with message for Subscribe newsletter and Cart booster)

**Appearance** (colors are set per campaign, in the campaign editor — NOT in Chatbox → Appearance):
- Background color — pop-up background
- Text color — message text
- Button background color
- Button label color

Each has color presets plus a custom color picker. See the dedicated "Change proactive chat pop-up colors" chunk below.

5. Check **Preview** to see how the campaign looks on your storefront
6. Click **Activate** to make it live

## Campaign Priority

When multiple campaigns could show at the same time:
1. Highest priority campaigns show first
2. Multiple campaigns can display per visitor per session
3. Set priorities in campaign settings (1 = highest priority)

## Marketing Double Opt-In (Subscribe Newsletter)

When enabled, customers receive a confirmation email before getting their discount.

## Timing Best Practices

- Welcome messages: 5-10 seconds after page load
- Product recommendations: After 30-50% page scroll
- Cart boosters: 2-3 minutes after adding items to cart
- Newsletter signup: Before exit intent or after browsing multiple products

## Changing Proactive Chat Pop-up Colors

The color of a proactive chat pop-up (the teaser message that pops up, e.g. "You might like this product!") is set **per campaign**, inside the proactive chat campaign editor — **not** in Chatbox → Appearance. Chatbox → Appearance only controls the chatbox/widget itself; the pop-up has its own colors.

To change them:

1. Go to **Proactive chat** and open (or create) the campaign
2. Scroll to the **Appearance** section in the campaign editor
3. Set each color — choose a preset swatch or use the custom color picker (the pencil/rainbow swatch):
   - **Background color** — the pop-up's background
   - **Text color** — the message text
   - **Button background color** — the CTA button fill
   - **Button label color** — the CTA button text
4. Use the **Message Preview** panel on the right to see changes live
5. **Save / Activate** the campaign

> Each proactive chat campaign has its own Appearance colors, so different campaigns can use different color schemes.

## Automatic Message After Order Placement

At the moment, Chatty doesn't support sending an automatic message directly after a customer places an order.

However, as a workaround, you can set up a **Proactive Chat** trigger that activates when a customer visits the order confirmation page, and pair it with a **Custom AI Scenario** to send a personalized follow-up message.

For a more fully automated post-order workflow, consider integrating with **Klaviyo** to handle post-purchase email automation.

## Customizing Product Recommendation CTA Buttons

Yes, you can customize the CTA button when setting up a **Proactive Chat campaign** with product recommendations — for example, configuring buttons such as **Add to Cart** or **Learn More** that link customers to the product page. This is edited under **Message content → Chat message** in that campaign.

If you need more specific customization for these buttons, share how you'd like them to work and our team can check what's possible.

> **This only applies to Proactive Chat campaign buttons.** The CTA button on the AI's own **product recommendation card** — shown directly inside a chat conversation when the AI suggests a product, labeled **View Product** — is a fixed system button and is **not customizable**. Before answering "yes, customizable," confirm whether the merchant means a Proactive Chat popup campaign (customizable) or the AI's in-chat product card (not customizable, always "View Product").

# Human Handover

## Human Handover Overview

Human handover controls when the AI hands a conversation off to your human team and where the customer goes after that. It is one of the **Customer support skills**.

Configure it at: **AI agent → Instructions → Assistant skills → Customer support skills → Human handover**.

The page has two parts:
1. **When should AI hand off to your team?** — auto triggers + intent rules
2. **Where does the customer go?** — destination + offline behavior

Two action buttons at the top:
- **Restore to default** — reset all handover settings to defaults
- **Test AI** — preview handover behavior without affecting live chat

---

## Auto Triggers — When AI Hands Off Automatically

Under "When should AI hand off to your team?", the **Auto triggers** section lets AI detect customer behavior and transfer automatically. Each trigger can be toggled on or off:

- **Customer asks to talk to a person** — `Always on` (cannot be turned off). AI detects intent like "talk to human", "speak to agent", "real person".
- **AI cannot answer** — auto hand-off after 2 consecutive low-confidence responses.
- **Customer repeats question** — auto hand-off when the same question is asked 2+ times.
- **Negative sentiment** — auto hand-off on frustration or anger, detected from wording, ALL CAPS, repeated punctuation, negative emojis (👎😠⚠️), or 2+ thumb-down reactions on AI replies.

---

## Intent Rules — Custom Transfer Topics

Below the auto triggers, **Intent rules** let the merchant define their own topics. The AI semantically matches the customer's message against these topics and transfers immediately — it does **not** send an AI response first.

To add one, click **+ Add rule** and define the topic.

Use this for topics that should always go straight to a human (e.g. cancellations, wholesale, legal requests).

---

## Where Does the Customer Go?

Under "Where does the customer go?", choose one of three destinations after a handover:

- **Transfer to human in Chatty inbox** (Recommended) — the agent joins the chat directly and the customer stays in the same window, no friction. Agent routing is managed in **Automation settings**; working hours are configured in **Chat availability settings**.
- **Collect info & follow up by email** — no live agents needed. AI collects customer details and sends a summary to your team email. Set a **Response time promise** shown to the customer (e.g. "When we're back online"). Support email addresses are edited in AI settings.
- **Show contact methods** — AI shows the contact methods configured in your **Chatbox settings** (phone, WhatsApp, email, contact form…) and lets the customer pick how to reach out.

---

## Offline Behavior (Transfer to Inbox option)

When the destination is **Transfer to human in Chatty inbox**, configure what happens when the team is offline.

**When your team is offline, show customers:**
- **Leave a message — we'll follow up** — AI collects email + issue description; the team follows up when back online. Set a **Response time promise** shown to the customer.
- **Show contact methods** — AI shows the contact methods configured in Chatbox settings so the customer can reach out while the team is away.

**While the customer waits for your team, let AI keep replying:**
- **Don't allow** — AI stops replying once the customer is waiting for an agent.
- **Allow only outside business hours** — when the team is offline, AI keeps handling the conversation instead of handing off.
- **Allow all the time** — AI keeps replying while the customer waits, even during business hours.

> Working hours are set in **Chat availability settings**.

---

## Custom Confirmation & Staff-Transfer Messages

Merchants can write their own custom text for two handover-related messages instead of using the default wording, both configured on the **Human handover** page itself (**AI agent → Instructions → Assistant skills → Human handover**):

- **Form confirmation message** — shown to the customer right after they submit a handover form (e.g. the "Collect info & follow up by email" or "Leave a message" flows above). This field is **required** — the merchant must fill it in, there's no default fallback.
- **Staff-transfer message** — the message shown to the customer when a chat is handed over to a human agent.

Both fields have a **500-character limit**, and edits show a **real-time preview** in the settings UI as the merchant types, so they can see exactly how the message will look before saving.

> These are separate from the **After-Sales Support** skill's own messages (open message + post-submit message) — see the next section. Those live on a different settings page, have a **300-character** limit per field, and are used only when the After-sales transfer method is "Transfer to email."

---

## After-Sales Support Skill (Order/Return/Refund Questions)

For merchants who want order-related questions (shipping status, returns, refunds,
"where's my order") to go to a **contact form** instead of the AI asking for
email/order number, the right setting is the **After-sales support** skill, not the
generic Human handover destination.

Configure it at: **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → Assistant skills → Customer
support skills → After-sales support**. It can run in parallel with a merchant's
own Custom Scenario on returns/refunds (see `faq_train-ai`).

Don't route this request through Human handover's "Show contact methods" — that
option is for general handover, not for gating order-related AI questions behind a
contact form.

> The message text shown to the customer around the After-sales contact form is
> **merchant-customizable**, not fixed — it isn't hardcoded copy.

**Custom After-Sales messages (added 14/07 and 06/08/2026):** the merchant can write two
of their own messages for this skill, on the **After-sales support** settings page itself
(**AI agent → Instructions → Manage → Assistant skills → After-sales support**):
- The message the AI sends when it opens the After-sales form.
- The message shown to the customer after they submit that form.

Each message has a **300-character limit**. Both only appear when the After-sales transfer
method is set to **Transfer to email** — they don't show for other transfer methods. If a
field is left blank, the system falls back to a default message in the customer's detected
language. Writing these messages does **not** count against the merchant's custom-scenario
limit.

# AI Training & Setup

## Setting Up AI Training for the First Time

To set up your AI agent, follow these steps:

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage** to add training data (Products, Collections, Discounts, Markets, FAQs, Custom knowledge)
2. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** to add custom instructions for how the AI should respond
3. Go to **AI agent** → **Settings** to set the AI name, avatar/logo, welcome message, and re-engagement
4. Click **Test AI** → **Test now** to test responses before going live

Would you like to set this up yourself, or have our team handle the full setup for you, free of charge? They'll train your AI assistant to fit your store, and you can adjust anything afterwards.

**How to answer this:** When a merchant asks how to set up their AI agent, give the setup steps above and the free-setup offer — nothing else. Do **not** add a note that advanced features or data sources require a paid plan; the merchant did not ask about plans, and leading with a paywall discourages setup. Only discuss plans or paid features if the merchant asks about pricing/plans directly, or when a step they want to take needs a feature their current plan doesn't include — at that point name the specific feature and point them to the pricing page. Advanced features that are paid-only: Store Instructions, Scenarios, QnA, and Data Source expansion (this list is for your reference, not for volunteering).

**For high-revenue stores** (ARR > $200K on a paid plan): proactively offer help with initial setup and a demo call with PM.

---

## Restoring Deleted AI Instructions

To recover deleted AI Instructions, contact support team for further help.

---

## Testing AI Responses

Use the built-in **Test** feature — it does **NOT** count against the merchant's AI replies quota.

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Test AI** → **Test now**
2. Enter questions and check AI responses

**Important:** Under the new pricing policy, each plan (except Plus) has limited AI Replies. Do not test directly on the merchant's live chat without permission.

---

## Prevent AI from Sharing Support Email

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **General instructions** → **Behaviours**
2. Add: `Do not provide Store Support Email addresses to customers.`
3. Save the changes
4. Test by asking "How can I contact support?" to confirm the email is no longer shown

---

## Disabling AI Follow-Up Questions

Follow-up questions — the AI suggesting a next question to keep the conversation going — are **off
by default**. A store only sees them if someone turned the *Product question suggestions* scenario on.
Check that first: if a merchant wants them gone, switching that scenario back off is usually all it
takes and they can do it themselves.

If they still appear after that, it has to be switched off for them on our side.

1. Confirm the merchant really wants the AI to answer directly, with no follow-up question
2. Tell them the team will switch it off for them, then hand it over so it can be applied
3. Explain the trade-off: answers get shorter and feel less personal afterwards
4. Once it is done, ask them to test again and confirm it matches what they wanted

---

## AI Showing Wrong Support Email

The AI pulls the support email from **AI agent** → **Settings** → **Support email addresses**.

1. Check which email the AI sent to the customer
2. Go to **AI agent** → **Settings** → **Support email addresses** and check the address set there (separate multiple addresses with commas)
3. If wrong, guide the merchant to update it with the correct one
4. After updating, the AI will automatically use the new email

---

## AI Not Replying to Emails

1. Verify AI email channel is enabled: **AI agent** → **Settings** → **AI Channels** → **Email**
2. AI auto-replies after 5 minutes if no agent responds — only to genuine customer inquiries (not spam or system notifications)
3. If configured correctly but AI still doesn't reply, escalate to the dev team

---

## AI Not Transferring to Human Agents

First check **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → Assistant skills → Customer support skills → Human handover**:
- **Auto triggers:** "Customer asks to talk to a person" is always on; "AI cannot answer", "Customer repeats question", and "Negative sentiment" are toggles — confirm the relevant trigger is enabled.
- **Destination:** confirm "Transfer to human in Chatty inbox" is selected (vs. "Collect info & follow up by email" / "Show contact methods").
- **Offline behavior:** if "Allow only outside business hours" / "Allow all the time" is set, AI keeps replying instead of handing off when the team is offline — this is expected.

If handover is configured correctly but the conversation still shows "Unassigned," agent routing is managed in **Automation settings** (check Automatic Assignment / "Reassign conversations"). If still failing, collect conversation details and escalate to TS/dev team.

---

## Hiding Product Preview Card

There is currently **no dedicated app setting** to disable product preview cards. The preview card shares CSS with the "Reply to" element — hiding via CSS would hide both.

- If merchant doesn't want AI to sell → suggest adjusting AI to focus on support skills instead
- If concerned about cluttered UI → explain the CSS limitation
- If they need more control → log feedback and escalate to the product team

---

## Product Card Detail Preview (In-Chat, added 25/05/2026)

Tapping a product card inside an AI chat opens a **Detail Preview** that covers the chatbox —
this is a richer, separate interaction from the plain card itself and is not covered by "Hiding
Product Preview Card" above (there's still no setting to disable either one).

What the Detail Preview shows:
- An image gallery (up to 6 photos, swipeable, with thumbnails and navigation)
- Product name, store name, and a **View on Store** link (opens the product page in a new tab)
- Variant selection — Color as a dropdown, other options (e.g. Size) as pill buttons; out-of-stock
  pills are disabled
- Price that updates with the selected variant, with the original price struck through when on sale
- A stock badge: In stock / Sold out / Back order
- An **Add to cart** button (quantity 1) — disabled when the selected variant is out of stock
- A shortened 3-line product description with a **Show more** toggle

This is available across plans wherever the AI's product recommendation cards appear in chat.

---

## AI Responds Before Pre-Chat Form

This happens when customers interact via the **AI Product Assistant** on the product page — it prioritizes quick answers without requiring customer info first.

If the merchant's priority is collecting customer info before any response, they should hide the **AI Product Assistant** on the storefront and rely solely on the pre-chat form.

---

## Creating an AI Scenario

Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **Assistant skills** → **Custom scenarios**, then click **+ Add scenario** and define:

1. **Scenario name** — the topic your customers mention
2. **Instructions** — the messages or flow you want the AI to follow

Use this for returns, order lookups, discount requests, or any specific process you want the AI to handle consistently.

---

## AI Product Sync Limits

| Plan | Product limit |
|------|--------------|
| Free | 200 products |
| Basic | 500 products |
| Pro | 8,000 products |
| Plus | Unlimited |

If the store exceeds the plan limit, Chatty trains on the most recently updated products first. For stores with more than 5,000 products, contact support — this requires manual backend configuration.

### "It won't upload all my products" / products missing from the list

If products are missing in **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage** → **Products**, check in this order:
1. **Deactivated products** — products toggled off in the list won't train; toggle them **Active**.
2. **A search or filter is hiding them** — clear any active search/filter.
3. **Header says "X of X products learned" but the list shows "No items found"** — clear the filter and switch to the **All** tab. If the list is still empty, escalate as a **display bug** (collect store URL + a screenshot).

---

## AI Product Inventory Sync

Chatty syncs product data including inventory status from Shopify. However, **real-time automatic stock quantity updates are not supported**.

To sync the latest data manually: **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage** → **Products** → click **Sync products**.

**Out-of-stock products are still learned.** The AI does train on products that are out of stock (as long as they are **Active** in Training data) — it does not skip them. When a customer asks about an out-of-stock item, the AI answers about the product and states that it is currently out of stock; it does not pretend the product doesn't exist. To stop the AI from answering about a specific item entirely, toggle that product **off (Disabled)** in **AI agent → Training data → Manage → Products**.

---

## Training Data Language

The AI performs best with training data in the same language your customers use. For multilingual audiences, you can add training data in multiple languages.

Avoid mixing languages in a single FAQ entry — it may reduce accuracy.

---

## Multilingual Product Descriptions

Chatty's AI reads Shopify product descriptions as written. If descriptions are available in multiple languages, the AI can answer in those languages.

For best results, ensure each product has complete descriptions in all supported languages. You can also add multilingual FAQs manually in **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage** → **FAQs**.

---

## AI Personalizes Using Shopify Customer Tags (added 29/05/2026)

When a customer is **logged in**, Chatty automatically adds that customer's **Shopify customer
tags** (e.g. VIP, wholesale, new customer) into the AI's context for that conversation. This lets
the AI tailor tone, product recommendations, and offers to the customer's segment.

To act on this, the merchant defines a rule referencing the tag in **General Instructions** or a
**Custom Scenario** — for example: *"If customer has tag 'VIP', prioritize premium products."*
Without a rule written by the merchant, the AI has the tag available but won't change behavior
on its own. This only works for logged-in customers — Chatty has no tag data for anonymous/guest
visitors.

---

## AI Page Context Detection

Yes — Chatty automatically detects the current page URL and product context. When a customer asks a question on a product page, the AI uses that product's information to answer.

Make sure the **Product recommendations** skill is enabled under **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Assistant skills** → **Shopping skills**.

---

## Collection-Based Product Recommendations

Yes — if the AI detects the customer is on a product or collection page, it can use that context to make relevant recommendations.

Make sure **Products** data is enabled in **Training data**. Use collection-specific scenarios to further improve accuracy.

---

## Prevent AI from Sharing Phone Number

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage** → **Custom knowledge** and remove/replace any phone number mentions with a redirect message: `For phone inquiries, please contact us via email.`
2. Create a **Custom scenario** (**AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **Assistant skills** → **Custom scenarios**): `Do not share the store phone number. Direct customers to contact us via email instead.`

---

## AI Shared an Unwanted Private Detail (Address, Personal Email, Other PII)

The AI only shares what's in its training data or settings — trace the source first. Open the offending answer → **Review Sources**; in real cases handled, the source has been either a merchant-added FAQ containing the detail, or the **Support email** field under **AI agent → Instructions**.

1. Remove or edit the entry containing the private detail.
2. Replace it with the contact information the merchant *does* want shared.
3. Add a boundary instruction under **AI agent → Instructions** covering that category of information (e.g. "Never share personal staff contact details or home addresses.").
4. Retest with a few phrasings to confirm it no longer surfaces.

If the merchant can't locate the source themselves, offer to make the change and verify it for them.

---

## Can the AI Read Images or Documents a Customer Sends?

The AI can match a **product photo** a customer sends against the synced catalog and reply about that specific product. It **cannot read or interpret uploaded documents** — PDFs, reports, forms, or other files sent by a customer in chat — and shouldn't be relied on for anything requiring document interpretation. Route those to a human via a **Human handover** intent rule.

(This is separate from a merchant *uploading* a PDF/CSV as training data under Custom knowledge — see the format table above; that's about feeding the AI's own knowledge, not about the AI reading files customers send mid-chat.)

---

## Best AI Training Content

Include:
- **Accurate product descriptions** with measurements, materials, and key specifications
- **FAQs** covering common questions (shipping, returns, sizing, payments)
- **Custom Scenarios** for specific flows like order status, discount codes, return requests

Keep content clear, avoid conflicting information, and update regularly as products or policies change.

---

## Size Recommendation Setup

1. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **Assistant skills** → **Custom scenarios** → **+ Add scenario**
2. Define triggers: `what size`, `size guide`, `how does it fit`
3. In the instructions, guide the AI to refer to the size chart or direct customers to the size guide page

Make sure product descriptions include clear size/measurement information.

You can also use the **Size guide agent** skill directly under **Assistant skills** → **Shopping skills** (requires plan upgrade).

---

## AI Giving Wrong Product Links

This usually means the AI matched a query to incorrect backend data (e.g., a collection lookup). Contact support with the **conversation ID** — the team will add an instruction hook to fix the response logic.

As a preventive step, ensure product descriptions are detailed and unambiguous.

---

## Product FAQs and "View Similar" Recommendations

No — product FAQs do **not** influence the "View Similar" recommendation feature. Recommendations are handled through **Smart Recommendations** settings, not FAQ data.

---

## Plan Product Limit Too Low

Each plan has a product sync limit (Free: 200, Basic: 500, Pro: 8,000, Plus: Unlimited). If you've hit the limit:

- Contact support and share what you need — the team will review and confirm if a one-time extension is possible (subject to approval)
- For permanent higher limits, upgrade your plan
- If you have more than 5,000 products, contact support directly — this requires manual backend configuration

---

## AI Using Wrong Store's Catalog

Contact support with the **conversation ID**. This is typically caused by the AI matching against backend collection data incorrectly. The team will add an instruction hook to prevent this behavior.

**Milder version — AI references product counts/categories that don't match what's actually synced, but the catalog is still the merchant's own store:** the same fix applies. Contact support with the **conversation ID** so the team can trace why the AI's referenced numbers diverge from **AI agent → Training data → Products**; don't assume it's the wrong-store issue above just because the catalog is stale-looking.

---

## AI and Website Content

**Note:** This applies to external websites only. Shopify store pages (About us, Shipping policy, Return policy, Privacy policy, Terms of service, FAQ, Contact us) are automatically synced — no URL submission needed for these.

For external websites: No — the AI does **not** automatically read your website. You must submit specific page URLs to the **Custom Knowledge** section.

Submitting just the domain (e.g., `yourstore.com`) only trains on the homepage content — submit individual page URLs for full coverage.

---

## What AI Model Does Chatty Use — Can I Use OpenAI / Switch the Model?

Chatty runs on a **secure, enterprise-grade large language model built for support**, upgraded regularly. The specific underlying model is not publicly disclosed, and the AI agent layer on top of it is optimized for e-commerce support scenarios.

**There is no option to plug in OpenAI or swap the underlying model** — not on any plan.

**If a merchant feels the replies are weak, the fix is almost always data/instruction quality, not the model:**
1. Set up **Assistant skills** — **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → Assistant skills**
2. Tighten the **General instructions** and add **Custom scenarios** for the cases they're unhappy with
3. Add **Custom knowledge** for anything the AI is missing
4. Re-test in **AI agent → Test AI → Test now** with the exact question that failed

Ask for the **specific example** that disappointed them — that is what makes the fix possible, and it's what the product team needs.

**Log the OpenAI / model-choice request as a feature request** with the merchant's use case and their example.

---

## AI Responding in Wrong Language

The AI is designed to respond in the customer's language. If it's getting confused (especially for very short or ambiguous messages), contact support with the **conversation ID**. The team can add an explicit instruction: `Always reply in the same language the customer is using.`

---

## AI Repeating Auto-Reply FAQ Content

This is a **known bug**. Contact support with the **conversation ID** — the dev team can investigate and fix the response logic so the AI does not repeat content already shown in the auto-reply.

---

## Suppressing Add-to-Cart Button

Scenario Instructions can set behavioral guidelines, but the Add-to-Cart button is a **system-level behavior** — it cannot be suppressed via scenario alone.

Contact support — the team can apply a custom instruction or CSS/code solution.

---

## AI Always Providing Contact Phone Number

Two approaches:
1. Add the phone number to **General AI Instructions** so the AI references it broadly
2. Create a **Custom Scenario** (**AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **Assistant skills** → **Custom scenarios** → **+ Add scenario**) triggered when customers ask about contacting the team

---

## AI Points to a Generic Contact Page / Wrong Contact URL

**Symptom:** the AI replies with a vague *"you can reach us via our contact page"* — with the wrong link, or no link at all.

**Fix:** add the merchant's **exact contact URL** to **AI agent → Instructions → Manage → General instructions** (or to Custom knowledge), so the AI references the right page instead of guessing. Re-test in **AI agent → Test AI**.

**If the merchant wants an on-store form rather than a link:**
- Chatty has a **built-in Contact form** section — it displays when a customer requests human/after-sales support. Submissions land in the **Inbox** and are also forwarded to the address set in **AI agent → Settings → Contact support email**.
- Chatty also integrates with **Powerful Contact Form** — set up in **Settings → Integrations** (see `faq_powerful-contact-form`). Each submission becomes a conversation in the inbox.

---

## AI and Loyalty Points / Customer Account Data

No — Chatty AI **cannot** access customer account data (login status, loyalty points balance, etc.).

As a workaround, create a **Custom Scenario** that directs customers to your login/registration page when they ask about rewards or account-specific questions.

---

## Custom Scenario Character Limit

Currently the character limit for individual scenario fields **cannot be increased**. Contact support — the team can help optimize and shorten the scenario text to fit within the limit.

**This is different from the Instructions field cap** (AI agent → Instructions → General instructions): that cap *can* be raised on request — contact support. If a merchant is out of room in Instructions, also suggest moving facts out: Instructions should describe *behaviour* (tone, boundaries, routing); product details, policies and reference info belong in **Training data → Custom knowledge**, which has a far more generous limit.

The **welcome/offline chatbox message fields** are a third, separate cap that is fixed and cannot be raised — see `faq_chatbox-settings.md`.

---

## AI and Shopify Metafields

Only **standard / supported** metafield types are synced to the AI. You can see and toggle which metafields are synced at **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage** → **Products** → **Manage metafields**.

**Not supported:** Non-standard / third-party **custom metafields** (for example, metafields created via a separate metafields app) are **not currently synced** — only the supported metafield types sync. Metaobject references (metafields that reference other metaobjects) are also not yet fully supported.

**Workaround:** Add that data into **Custom knowledge** as a Q&A so the AI can still use it. If supporting a specific metafield type matters to the store, log a **feature request** with the merchant's use case so the product team can prioritize it.

---

## AI Says "No Access" to Product Specs, Size Charts, or FAQ Metafields

When the AI replies "I don't have access to that information" even though the data is on your product pages, work through these:

1. Confirm the product is **Active** in **AI agent → Training data → Products** and that sync has finished (it can lag a few minutes after install/upload).
2. Standard product fields (title, description, variants, price, availability) and **supported metafields** sync — toggle them in **Products → Manage metafields**. However, **product-page "FAQ" / spec metafields and many third-party/custom metafields are not reliably indexed today**, so technical specs stored only in those tabs may not reach the AI. Re-enter those facts as text in **Custom knowledge** (Q&A) or a CSV.
3. **Images are not read.** A **size chart saved as an image won't be parsed** — re-enter that data as text in Custom knowledge or a CSV; don't rely on an image.
4. For FAQ/Q&A content, make sure the topic is **Active** and the question is phrased plainly.

As a catch-all, put the missing facts into **Custom knowledge** and re-test in **Test AI**. If correctly-synced data still isn't used, send the **conversation ID** so the team can trace it (FAQ/custom-metafield sync is a known coverage gap and can be logged as a feature request).

## Uploading Files for AI Training

Go to **AI agent** → **Training data** → **Manage** → **Custom knowledge** → **Add data** → **Files**.

| Format | Notes |
|--------|-------|
| PDF | Supported; not ideal for structured data |
| CSV | **Recommended** for product catalogs and structured Q&A |
| TXT | Supported |
| JSON | Supported |

- Max file size: **2MB per file**
- For large product catalogs → CSV gives better results than PDF
- AI uses RAG — similar customer questions match the closest trained entry

---

## AI Language Switching / Wrong Language Response

1. Go to **Settings → Translation** → confirm the correct **default language** is set
2. Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **General instructions** → **Behaviours** → add:
   > *"Always respond in the same language as the customer."*
3. For real-time translation between agent and customer in the inbox → requires **Pro or Plus plan**

> Free/Basic plans: AI responds based on training data language + customer input. Explicit instruction in step 2 is the most effective fix.

---

## Setting AI Brand Voice / Tone

Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **General instructions** → **Communication style** or **Behaviours**, and add brand tone guidelines. Examples:

- *"You are a friendly assistant for [Brand]. Use warm, casual language."*
- *"Never say 'I apologize' — say 'I'm sorry' instead."*
- *"Write in UK English. Use formal but approachable language."*
- *"Keep responses concise — no more than 3 sentences unless the question requires detail."*

Many merchants skip the Instructions setup entirely — if AI sounds generic, this is the first thing to configure.

---

## Disabling AI Product Recommendations

**Option 1 — Toggle Smart Recommendations off:**
Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **Assistant skills** → **Shopping skills** → **Product recommendations** → Toggle **OFF**

**Option 2 — Custom Instruction:**
Go to **AI agent** → **Instructions** → **Manage** → **General instructions** → **Behaviours** and add: *"Do not recommend products unless the customer explicitly asks for a recommendation."*

> Product recommendations is a **Pro+ feature**. On lower plans, AI uses general product sync — disable via Behaviours instructions.

---

## Changing AI Bot Name / Welcome Message / Avatar

The AI's **display name** — the name customers see on the AI's messages — is set at
**AI agent** → **Settings** → **Name**. The avatar and welcome message live in the same
place, under **AI agent** → **Settings** → **AI identity**.

Tone and self-description are configured separately, at **AI agent** → **Instructions** →
**Manage** → **General instructions**:

- **Role** → describe who the assistant is and how it presents itself (max 250 chars)
- **Communication style** → choose Friendly / Professional / Empathetic / Custom
- **Behaviours** → customize conversation style (max 1000 chars)

Changes apply immediately. No republishing required.

> Editing **Role** changes how the AI describes itself, not the name shown on its
> messages. To rename the assistant, change **AI agent → Settings → Name**.
> See `faq_ai-agent-settings` for the full breakdown.

# Inbox

## Chatty Inbox Overview

The Inbox is your central hub for managing all customer conversations across all connected channels — live chat, email, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp — in one place.

**Access inbox:** Go to Chatty in Shopify admin → click the **Inbox** tab.

**Reply to a conversation:**
1. Select a conversation from the list
2. Click the message input field at the bottom
3. Type your message → press **Enter** or click **Send**

For AI-assigned conversations: click **Join conversation** to start responding. You can reassign to AI anytime for auto-reply to resume.

**Filter conversations by:**
- Status: Open, Resolved, Starred, Blocked, Unread
- Channel: Online store, Live chat, Email, Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp
- Assignee: Your inbox, Unassigned, or a specific team member

**While chatting you can see:**
- Contact info, order history, customer tags and notes
- Pages they've browsed
- Real-time behaviors: viewing FAQs, adding/removing products from cart, placing an order

---

## Who a Conversation Gets Assigned To

**Automatic assignment is on by default.** The first team member to reply to a conversation becomes
its assignee, and it stays with them. Nothing is shared out in rotation and nobody is skipped for
being offline unless the store changes those options under **Settings** → **Automation** →
**Assignment method**.

That default explains most of *"why did this land on my colleague?"* — they answered first. It also
explains a member seeing fewer conversations than they expect: once a conversation has an assignee,
it leaves the unassigned queue.

---

## Starting a New Conversation From the Admin (Outbound)

You can proactively start a conversation with a customer from the inbox — you don't have to wait for them to message you first.

**How to create one:**
1. In the **Inbox**, click the **`+`** icon at the top right of the conversation list.
2. In the **Create conversation** popup, fill in:
   - **Email** — the customer's email address (required)
   - **Participants** — optional, up to 5 additional email addresses to include on the thread
   - **Subject of the email** — optional subject line
3. Click **Create**, then type your message and send.

This is an **email conversation** — your message is delivered to the customer's email address, and their replies thread back into your Chatty inbox.

---

## "Send Email" Button Missing When I Start a Conversation Myself

This is expected — it's not a bug.

When you **reply to an existing conversation**, the **"Send email"** button appears because Chatty needs you to confirm which channel that reply goes out on (the customer may have reached you via web chat, Messenger, etc.).

When you **start a new conversation yourself** via the **`+` → Create conversation** flow, you already entered the customer's **email and subject** in the popup, so the channel is set to **email** from the start. Everything you send in that thread goes to the customer's email automatically — there's no separate "Send email" button to click.

**In short:** an admin-initiated conversation created with the customer's email *is* an email conversation. Your messages are emailed to the customer; the missing button just means the email channel is already selected for you.

---

## Anonymous Users Showing Random Names

When a visitor hasn't given their details, Chatty needs some label to identify the conversation in the inbox. Merchants can choose between three display modes at **Settings → Chat appearance → Inbox settings**:

1. **Random names** (default) — a random label like "Grateful dream" or "thunder flake".
2. **Fixed anonymous label** — the visitor shows as "Anonymous-xxx" instead of a random name.
3. **Sequential numbers** — visitors are labeled in order, e.g. "Visitor #1", "Visitor #2".

Two other things CS can do:
- **Remove the `{{customer_name}}` variable** from the AI welcome message (**AI agent → Settings → AI identity → Welcome message**) — the visitor label then only appears in the inbox, never spoken to the customer.
- If the merchant wants to capture real names instead, suggest enabling the **pre-chat form** (**Chatbox → Chat page → Pre-chat Form**) with Name set as required.

---

## Blocked Customers Starting New Conversations

Blocking in Chatty is currently **session-based** and does not permanently prevent a visitor from starting a new conversation.

For more persistent control:
- Block by IP address (if your store platform supports this)
- Use **Shopify customer tags** to flag or manage abusive customers

The dev team is researching improvements to this feature.

---

## Blocking Visitors by Country

Chatty doesn't currently support blocking all visitors from a specific country at once.

You can block individual visitors — open the conversation, click on the visitor profile, and select **Block**.

For country-level restrictions, consider using **Shopify's geo-blocking features** or a third-party geolocation app.

---

## Stopping Spam / Bot Traffic

There's no automated bot detection or IP filtering built in today. What helps in practice:

- Enable the **pre-chat form** (**Chatbox → Chat page → Pre-chat Form**) requiring name and email — the friction removes most automated traffic.
- Block at the platform or CDN level if the traffic comes from identifiable sources.
- **Resolve** or **Delete** spam conversations in the Inbox to keep it clean (blocking itself is session-based — see above).
- If spam is inflating AI conversation usage, set a spending cap under **Subscription → View details → Change limit** while working on a longer-term fix.

Bot filtering and a CAPTCHA option are both logged as feature requests.

---

## Reassigning Conversation Back to AI

In the Inbox, open the conversation and look for the assign/reassign option — select the **AI agent** as the assignee.

Note: the customer must send a **new message** after reassignment for the AI to start handling the conversation again.

---

## Replying as Yourself (Not as Admin)

Each team member should log in with their own Chatty account.

If replies are showing as "Admin," check **Settings** → **Automation** — the assignment rule may be keeping conversations assigned to the admin. Change the setting to **"Assign to whoever replies"** to resolve this.

---

## Multiple Shopify Stores

**A unified inbox across several stores exists, and it is a Plus-plan feature.** On Plus, a member
can connect their other stores and work all of their conversations from one inbox, up to **10
connected stores** (the main store is not counted towards that ten).

On Free, Basic and Pro there is no unified inbox: each store has its own Chatty and the merchant
signs into each one separately. That is the correct answer for most merchants asking — but never
answer that the feature does not exist, because on Plus it does.

**Connecting a second store to the same account:** Install Chatty on the second store and, when activating the web app account, click **Activate** to link it to your existing account. You can then switch between stores from the web app (app.meetchatty.com) using the **store switcher in the top-left corner**.

**Limitations:** Each store keeps its own separate inbox and its own plan — conversations are not merged. On mobile, you only receive notifications for the store you're currently switched to (the store name is not shown in the notification). Workaround: use a separate device per store.

---

## Mark All as Read

A "Mark all as read" feature is **not available yet**. This has been submitted as a feature request to the product team.

---

## Exporting Conversation History

Currently, Chatty supports exporting **individual conversations** only — open the conversation → click the **⋮ menu** (top right) → **Export transcript** to download that conversation.

Bulk export with a date range filter is not available in the app UI. If you need to export multiple conversations, contact support with the date range and the team can export the data and send it to your email.

---

## Migrating Data to a New Store

Automatic store-to-store migration is **not supported**. Conversation history is tied to the specific store (not the account or domain), so it cannot be transferred even with the same login email or domain — a new store starts fresh.

You can manually copy your **AI Instructions, Scenarios, and FAQ/Q&A content** to the new store. Widget and chatbox settings must be reconfigured.

**Importing history from a different chat platform (not Chatty→Chatty):** there's no migration tool for this either — historical conversations/tickets stay in the previous platform. What does carry over easily is the merchant's knowledge: export existing FAQs or macros from the old platform and import into Chatty via **FAQs → More actions → Import FAQs**, or add them as Q&As under **Training data → Custom knowledge**. Offer to help set this up as part of onboarding if the merchant shares the content or page URL.

---

## Chat History via API

The **Chatty Public API does support pulling conversations and messages** — you can list a conversation's messages via the API. There are also **webhooks** (e.g. `customer_message`, `ai_response`) that push chats to your own server in near real time.

**API key generation and webhooks are Pro/Plus only** — on Free/Basic the merchant must upgrade to generate a key. See `faq_klaviyo` → *Chatty Public API & Webhooks*.

What is **not** available via the API is a **bulk full-conversation / date-range export** — for that, route the merchant to support, or use the **Zendesk** integration (all Chatty conversations are automatically saved as Zendesk tickets when marked resolved). The support team can also manually export transcripts.

---

## Star Icon on Conversations

The **star icon** on a conversation indicates that the conversation is currently being handled by the **AI agent**.

---

## Where Chat Images and Files Are Stored

Images and files that customers send in chat are stored in the merchant's **Shopify Files**
(Shopify Admin → Content → Files). On the **Free plan** this is the only storage option, so
chat attachments will always appear there.

To store chat attachments in external storage instead of Shopify Files, upgrade to a paid plan.

## Finding the Inbox in Shopify Mobile Admin

On the Shopify mobile app, the Chatty Inbox is **not** in the app's "..." menu (that menu only
has Manage app, Get support, Pin, and Uninstall).

Tap the **hamburger menu next to the search field in the header**, then find **Inbox** under
the **Chatty** app.

## Cannot Find Messages in Inbox

1. **Check all tabs** — inbox tabs are **All, Your Inbox, Unassigned, Blocked**; also check the **Status** filter (Open, Resolved, Starred, Blocked, Unread) — conversations may be sitting under Unassigned or Resolved
2. **Check channel filter** — message may be from a different channel (email vs. web chat); use the channel filter to switch views
3. **If inbox shows error code** (e.g., "9 Failed Pre-conditioning") → clear browser cache, refresh the page; if error persists → escalate to TS with the error code
4. **If using search** → try browsing manually instead; search may miss recently received messages

---

## Customer Chatted But No Conversation Found

If a customer says they talked to Chatty but you can't locate the conversation:

- Anonymous chats appear under a **random/visitor name, not the customer's order email** — search by the **approximate date** rather than by email. Check every tab (Open, Resolved, Spam/Automated) and clear filters.
- If it genuinely never appears, it may be tied to the current **inbox-loading / 404 defect** (see "404 / Inbox-Crash" in the Others doc) — collect the customer email, approximate date/time, store URL and a screenshot, and escalate so the team can trace it server-side.
- Don't promise a conversation existed if it can't be located — some "the bot told my customer X" reports turn out to be email threads or other channels.

## Conversations Mixing Between Threads / Inbox Lagging

For stores with a very large volume of conversation data, the inbox can lag while fetching and rendering, sometimes requiring a page refresh to load the latest messages.

Cases where messages appear to **mix between different conversation threads** are treated as **high-priority and escalated to the dev team** for investigation. If a merchant experiences this, collect the affected **conversation IDs** and escalate so the team can investigate thoroughly.

---

## Mark All Conversations as Resolved

There is currently **no bulk "resolve all" button** in the inbox. Conversations must be resolved individually.

**Feature request:** This has been logged with the product team.

**For large volumes:** Contact support — the team may be able to help with a backend bulk resolve for your account.

---

## ⚠️ Bulk Conversation Delete — Also Permanently Deletes Contacts (as of 05/08)

As of **05/08**, Chatty supports **bulk deleting conversations** from the Inbox (selecting and deleting multiple conversations at once, rather than one at a time).

**Warning — this is destructive and irreversible:** bulk-deleting conversations does **not** just remove the conversation records. It also **permanently deletes the associated contact records** for every customer whose conversation was included in the bulk delete. There is no undo.

**Guidance for CS and the bot:**
- Do **not** suggest bulk conversation delete casually as a way to "clean up" the inbox (e.g. for spam or clutter) — it will wipe out real contact data along with it.
- Before recommending or confirming a bulk delete, make sure the merchant understands both the conversations **and** the linked contacts (profile, order history, tags/notes) will be gone permanently.
- Treat this the same as any other irreversible/destructive action — flag the risk clearly rather than walking through it like a routine cleanup step.

See `kb/faq/contacts.md` for how contact records and deletion work.

---

## Custom Attribute Search

Conversations can be searched by **custom attribute values** — for example, searching for all conversations tagged with a "Pre-order" custom attribute.

**Limit:** a conversation can carry up to **50 custom attribute values**.

---

## Inbox Search Bar Also Matches Phone Number, Order Number, and Conversation Tag (added 29/05/2026)

The Inbox search bar isn't limited to name and email anymore — it also matches **phone number**,
**order number**, and **conversation tag**. This helps when a customer contacted through a
different channel and the merchant only has their phone number, or when the merchant needs to
find a conversation tied to a specific order.

Search results respect whatever filters are already active (status, assignee, etc.) — search
narrows within the current filtered view rather than replacing it.

---

## Reopening a Resolved Conversation

Open the conversation from the **Resolved** tab — there is a **Reopen** button at the top. It moves the conversation back to the **Open** list.

Customers have no "Unresolve" control: a resolved conversation reopens on their side only when they send a new message, and after ~5 days of inactivity a new message starts a brand-new conversation instead.

See `faq_others` → *Reopening / Un-resolving a Conversation*.

---

## Customer Replies Go to Chatty Inbox

This is **expected behavior** for the email channel — all replies are threaded in Chatty's inbox for unified management.

**If the merchant wants replies to go directly to their email client:**
1. Go to **Channels → Email → Email sender** settings → check the **Reply-To** field
2. Set the Reply-To address to the merchant's actual support email
3. Customers' replies will then arrive at both Chatty and the configured email client

> Explain to merchants that the Chatty inbox is the intended management hub. The Reply-To field workaround is for merchants who prefer their traditional email workflow.

---

## Anonymous Conversations With Pre-Chat Form Enabled

Two features can bypass the pre-chat form:

1. **AI Product Page Assistant** — when embedded on product pages, customers can chat immediately without providing their email. The system prioritizes fast support.
2. **Proactive Chat** — when enabled, customers can reply to the proactive chat bubble without filling the pre-chat form first.

**Solution:** If you want to enforce info collection for all conversations, disable the AI Product Page Assistant embed and/or Proactive Chat features.

## Suggest Reply (Beta)

A **"Suggest reply"** capability is in **Beta**: the AI drafts a response that an agent reviews before sending (AI generates → human reviews → human presses **Send**), so it does not auto-send to your company email.

- It's being rolled out to **select merchants** — if a merchant wants in, log their interest.
- Known Beta limitations: the drafted-email **formatting/spacing** still needs polish, and suggestions **aren't always accurate** (e.g. it suggested "in stock" when the item was out of stock).
- Until it's GA, keep the AI **off** for company email if every email could get an incorrect auto-reply, and use it on **live chat** where an agent can supervise.
